responsibility: This header declares the basic string I/O interface layered on StdIO in the mc-boot runtime. It exports line output, editable line input into caller-provided buffers, and string output procedures, forming the public contract for simple text interaction rather than low-level character or file primitives.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the public declaration half of the GStrIO pair, advertising WriteLn, ReadString, and WriteString, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStrIO.cc contains their terminal-I/O and line-editing implementation.
